scope: Adaptive integration continuation and cost-bounded method comparison

reused_proofs.reason_not_rederived: The assumptions and proof obligations are unchanged. New source semantics are audited separately.

results.statement: Preserving the complete deterministic integrator state preserves the attempt trace under identical forced stops and callback outcomes.
results.implemented: DOPRI5 session; RODAS native coalesced invocation within a batch
results.not_implemented: General persistent RODAS session across method-comparison batches

results.statement: For zero estimator, geometric growth and endpoint-only clipping, n(L)=ceil(log_g(1+(g-1)L/h0)).
results.does_not_claim: The no-interior-barrier count equals current coalesced RODAS cost.

results.native_wrapper_already_implemented: Accepted forced slivers with kappa<0.5 restore requested_h without recording the accepted error; informative clipped samples bound/restore the request using predicted unclipped error.
results.does_not_claim: The raw ratio diagnoses an unresolved native clipping bug. The actual wrapper changes the final proposal.
results.implementation_action: Preserve existing clipping restoration; record proposal and actual trial separately; investigate loss of native proposal at facade restarts.

results.requirement: A valid induced-norm bound ||Q||<=eta<1, or original-target residual combined with a separately certified inverse/output sensitivity bound. Residual alone is not a forward error certificate.
results.approximate_inverse_action_obligation: The theorem uses exact inverse(W); a supplied approximate action R needs its own certified action/output error or a certified defect norm ||I-R*Wprime||<1.
results.check: noncommuting exact rational 2x2 fixture in THEORY_CHECKS.json

results.dopri_unit: one entire native attempt; at most 7 RHS calls, 6 with valid FSAL; completion is processed before ceiling check
results.rodas_unit: one callback; Jacobian weight n, RHS/JVP/ft weight 1
results.parallel_bound_requirement: Include all already in-flight callback weights
results.next_action: Reserve ceiling+overshoot+verification before running if integrating the existing cumulative credit policy.

results.distinction: Transfers mean accepted h from a successful entry pilot; later implicit-window mean seeding already existed.
results.seed: max(user_h0, (pilot_end-pilot_start)/pilot_accepted_steps), only using a finite positive mean from a positive accepted count and winning completed pilot
results.common_facade_clamp: local_h0=max(min(seed,batch_target-start),native_min_step), followed by native actual-landing clipping; the nondecrease guarantee is relative to disabled reuse at the same checkpoint and batch span
results.revision_1_superseded_variant: Unconditionally using the mean could lower user_h0 and caused a case5 work regression.
results.benefit: Can remove repeated small-initial-step growth; conditional on the seed remaining representative locally.
results.risk: A stale mean can increase rejections after a transition.
results.required_comparison: Same case, checkpoint policy, accuracy target and work accounting with seed reuse disabled.

results.trigger: The first qualifying zero-accepted, incomplete, nonfatal implicit pilot anywhere in an explicit tenure; not necessarily the tenure's first actual pilot.
results.action: At arming set used=true and pending=true; retain pending across ineligible prefixes; in serial control flow compared() clears pending after the actual comparison returns, while Err terminates the solve. Used prevents rearming within the tenure.
results.cost_bound_unit: The same charged callback units as the ceiling, not elapsed time or an aggregate proxy with additional linear-algebra costs.
results.rodas_maximum_checked_unit: max(1, dimension), with in-flight allowance required for concurrent callbacks
results.selection_criterion_unchanged: Only a completed, economical actual same-checkpoint pilot permits method entry.
not_claimed: Total pilot count differs from baseline by at most one
required_tests: first qualifying zero-progress loss may occur after earlier completed pilots
used is set at arming; repeated failures cannot rearm within same tenure
ineligible prefixes retain pending; compared() clears it after return; Err terminates
uneconomical completed pilots do not trigger startup exception
all work and accepted checkpoint accounting is preserved

production_validation_requirements: Total cost includes discarded candidates and recoverable/fatal callbacks
Accepted state matches returned time after interruption
Optional unused implicit providers do not block viable explicit execution
Separate serial and parallel in-flight cost assumptions
No statistical false-positive claim without a specified population and ground truth
